killCriteria.notes: darkPatternInLoop: nothing I saw could be skipped for money; the 20-minute rest ('Rest 1200s', later 'Rest assigned 141m/203m') is not purchasable. But the death screen puts 'BUY sword +1 $200' directly under 'YOU DIED', and the mother-reward pick is priced 'pick ◇◇◇◇ ok $480' - soft-currency nudges, recorded as friction, not as a criterion failure. unfairDeathShareAbove10pct: 4 deaths in the horizon; the closest to unfair is #8 D8 'died to goblin' whose own trace says 'bank at 25% fired' and then shows the goblins finishing him while he walked home; the game's own verdict machine called #20 'bad luck · 1 in 6' with '10/12 replays survive' and offered two computed fixes, so I did not judge the vocabulary unable to address it. defaultRulesBeatEveryEdit: not testable by me (the bot proxy is the coordinator's); the in-game preview proved edits move the odds ('EDIT · D9 63->13% · full haul 50->13%'), and my two authored rules fired ('own rules 1%').

criterion.delayedRecall: same-day: I spent 2 upgrade tokens to give my fighter the 'Steady L2' stance, then sent him at a goal of D5 and watched a 4.7-minute run bank $52 after a rat died to a +1 sword. Then I hired the $80 Scout so he would go without me, and the 4-hour absence came back with 8 runs, one death, a legendary Crownsplitter and the Goblin Warlord dead on the second try. The next night came back with the Bloat Mother dead, 13 runs, 3 graves to recover and the rule editor finally unlocked - which is when I wrote my own 'unknown item + hp < 50% -> read unknown' and watched him identify a teleport scroll.

report.scoreTotal: see run below (eval/score.sh was run on this file after writing)
gripes: The rule writer - the reason to play - says 'Read only · Custom rules · after Bloat Mother' for the first several hours, so the thing the game is about is not the thing the first hour is about, and the 200 calls I had ran out before I could play with it.

The watch chooses its own speed: the chip read 'quiet · 48x', then 16x, then 'fight · 1.5x', and tapping the Speed button changed nothing I could hold - so the 'watch at 1x' the brief assumes does not exist for me, and a whole run resolves in about 30 seconds.

Panels clip and hide: 'compare outcomes' was cut off at the Tactics panel edge until I dragged it, the rule list lives under a collapsed '▸ Packages 10', and the town prep sheet re-renders into the rule editor without saying it did - I spent a dozen calls looking for a screen I was already standing on.
tellAFriend: Send the hero away for a night and the morning report is a scroll: 13 runs, 3 graves to dig up, two bosses down and a legendary with an effect and a trade-off.
When he dies the game replays the fight twelve times, tells you it was '1 in 6', shows the tick where 'bank at 25%' fired too late, and offers you two fixes with their costs printed side by side.

You never issue an order mid-run - you write the standing rules ('unknown item + hp < 50% -> read unknown'), watch them fire on a fast-forward map, and the report tells you what share of decisions were yours ('own rules 1% · defaults 19% · chores 81%').
